sourcesRead.what: Product page: compatibility (iPhone/iPod touch iOS 15+, Apple Watch watchOS 10+; no iPad listed), languages, accessibility (none declared)
Homepage incl. 'Strong has all the features' list (two variants in HTML)
Title only, no body content in HTML
Lists only /, /cloud, /style-tags, /love, /share-link-expired; /love is testimonials only (not used)
HelpScout Docs; 68 articles, all fetched and read

removed.quote: Strong is no longer supporting direct MyFitnessPal integration. Please use our Apple Health for iPhone integration instead
As a result of Google's deprecation of the Google Fit API, Strong 2.X is no longer able to support Google Fit Integration.

notes: Website /features is password-protected and /cloud, /pro have no content; homepage feature strip is the only website feature list. The homepage HTML carries two variants of that strip; only one adds 'Workout Scheduling, Muscle Heat Map'. Help article 242 (undated) lists Scheduling and a Web App as things being worked on, so 'Workout scheduling' is a weakly-supported claim — consider dropping it. Web app NOT claimed (roadmap). '3rd Party Integrations' on homepage is too vague to count; specific integrations captured instead (Apple Health; Health Connect on Android). No native iPad app: App Store compatibility lists only iPhone, iPod touch and Apple Watch. Several help articles describe Android-only/iPhone-only differences (template folders iPhone-only; hiding exercises iOS-only; dumbbell doubling setting iOS-only). 'Import workouts from Apple Health' and 'Rest timer notifications' are evidenced only by performance/fix release notes. Many help articles reference 'future improvements' (watch redesign, independent watch app, more export options, Android folders) — all excluded. App Store body copy says 'Strong PRO' gates templates>3, body-part measurements, charts, plate & warm-up calculators, custom icons/themes — pricing not recorded per brief. Help centre is HelpScout (no Zendesk API); all 68 sitemap articles fetched directly.
